team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock n/a turns vs floor 11 (3 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Use organizer-style calculator / lab constraints; no internet.
Physical instruments may be proxied; do not invent unavailable readings.
Official home page: each country sends two teams of three; two experimental assignments spanning biology/chemistry/physics skills.
Age: may only turn 17 during the EOES year (never older than 17).
Emphasis on team division of labor; ~4 hours per assignment described on home page.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: experiment lead
duties: Decide the procedure and the order of measurements.
State the setup precisely enough for another team to repeat it.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: data recorder
duties: Record every measurement with units and stated uncertainty.
Never adjust a recorded value to fit an expectation.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: analysis / calculations
duties: Turn recorded data into the required quantities, showing the work.
Carry uncertainty through the calculation instead of dropping it.

answer_format: Submit a lab-style report: data, calculations, tables/graphs description, and conclusions.
rules_text: European Olympiad of Experimental Science (EOES / EUSO). The team of 3 runs a practical task and reports raw data, analysis, and conclusions on the official answer sheet. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official wall-clock timing is not encoded for this track; treat the turn budget as your clock and submit before it runs out. Simulation note: the hands-on portion is represented in text, so state measurements, setup, and reasoning explicitly instead of demonstrating them.
